channel.description: Latest articles from The Berkshire Edge (theberkshireedge.com)

item.title: Gov. Healey takes action to keep ICE out of schools, hospitals, courthouses, and places of worship
item.description: The legislation would prohibit warrantless ICE arrests in schools, hospitals, courthouses, and houses of worship; the governor's executive order bars civil arrests in state facilities without judicial warrants.

item.title: From Berkshire Busk! to public Wi-Fi, Housatonic Improvement Committee discusses early-2026 community initiatives and updates
item.description: Housatonic Improvement Committee Chair Sara Parker opened the group's first meeting of 2026 with a statement of community strength and gratitude, concluding with `“… building a web of neighbors is what we’re all doing here tonight, and I’m grateful to be building this with all of you.”

item.title: What to do if you encounter ICE: Ben Hillman and Big Tentacle release ICE preparedness posters in five languages
item.description: Big Tentacle's free posters, now available in five languages including Somali, provide guidance on ICE encounters as creator Ben Hillman urges direct action to support immigrant communities.

item.title: Berkshire region real estate sales – January 30, 2026
item.description: Weekly real estate transactions for Berkshire County in Massachusetts, Litchfield County in Connecticut, and Columbia County in New York.

item.title: Masterfully Reimagined 1861 Post & Beam Barn
item.description: Philip Feiner of Country Life Real Estate offers you a rare opportunity to own a masterfully reimagined circa-1861 post-and-beam barn, transformed into a one-of-a-kind luxury estate set on 89 pristine acres in the heart of Columbia County.

item.title: BITS & BYTES: Taha Clayton at Tremaine Gallery; CATA at Good Purpose Gallery; Olwen O’Herlihy Dowling at Springfield Museums; Jewish Federation presents Rachel Simons; Cross-country at Great Mountain Forest
item.description: In 2024, one of Taha Clayton’s paintings was selected for the Lunar Codex “Nova Collection,” sending an image of his work to the surface of the moon as part of a time capsule that will remain there indefinitely.

item.title: A recipe for Pasta Bolognese from ‘What’s on the Board?’ by Neil Fox
item.description: Tonight my old friend and fellow ad guy Joel and his wife Donna are coming for dinner. I’m making one of their favorite dishes: Pasta Bolognese.

item.title: REAL ESTATE MARKET WATCH: 2025 Sales in Review
item.description: Sandy Caroll, chief executive officer of the Berkshire County Board of Realtors, summarizes 2025 sales: residential up, land down. But the real story is in the details.

item.title: Welcome to Real Estate Friday!
item.description: Philip Feiner of Country Life Real Estate offers you a rare opportunity to own a masterfully reimagined circa-1861 post-and-beam barn, transformed into a one-of-a-kind luxury estate set on 89 pristine acres in the heart of Columbia County. The biggest challenge for architect Andrew Webster of Graphite Studio was to preserve the charm and character of a two-hundred-year-old building while delivering 21st century performance and comfort. A report on real estate sales in the fourth quarter of 2025.

item.title: AT THE TRIPLEX: What the snubs say about this year’s Oscars
item.description: In a year as jam-packed with quality as 2025 was, these nominations are a reminder of why it is worth braving the winter weather to see them the way they were meant to be seen: on the big screen.
